title: IncrementalRegressionKernel Predict
text: Predict responses using incremental kernel regression model, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Inner product data type} sets Inner product data type; {Select initial machine learning model} sets the initial incremental kernel regression model, {Add output port for status of trained machine learning model} adds second output port for model status, {Sample time (–1 for inherited)} sets the option to specify sample, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Output data type} sets the data type of yfit output Inherit, {Output data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of yfit output for range checking, {Output data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of yfit output for range checking, {Kernel data type} sets the kernel computation data type, {Kernel data type Minimum} sets the minimum kernel computation value for range checking, {Kernel data type Maximum} sets the maximum kernel computation value for range checking, {Inner product data type Minimum} sets the minimum of inner product term for range checking and {Inner product data type Maximum} sets the maximum of inner product term for range checking. Values come from the instance.
